summary: Eight base records qualify under the business rules (R6807, R1278, R3282, R2008, R6608, R1596, R9925 — plus R8212 which is a duplicate of R6807). After deduplication by entity_id, seven unique qualifying comps exist. The top five, ranked by distance ascending then most recent close date, are R6807 (0.80 mi), R1278 (1.03 mi, updated via executed amendment U-R1278-1 to $9.3M), R3282 (1.26 mi, base $9.2M — post-cutoff amendment U-R3282-2 ignored), R2008 (1.49 mi, unsigned draft U-R2008-3 ignored), and R6608 (1.72 mi). Normalized price per square foot ranges from $125.00 to $135.17, with a $125.00 median across the shortlist.
limitations: U-R3282-2 (executed amendment) is effective 2026-09-10, after the 2026-08-31 cutoff, so the base $9.2M is used; if that amendment becomes controlling at a later cutoff, R3282's consideration would drop to a $1 nominal figure and require re-evaluation for 'positive consideration' materiality.
R2008 has an unsigned draft (U-R2008-3) proposing $5.0M consideration; not applied per rules, but a future executed version could change eligibility ordering.
R2044 was published 2026-09-03 (after cutoff) and is excluded even though its event date is within the window.
R2134 has null consideration — treated as unknown, not zero; a subsequent disclosure could bring it in-scope.
R8212 is treated as a second source for R6807 and dropped as a duplicate; if the two records actually represent distinct transactions on the same asset, dedup logic would need revisiting.
No geocoded coordinates were provided; the 8-mile screen relies on the supplied distance_miles field.
